messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT fired -> PD#INC-4829 for region=az3 service=runtime-serving severity=sev2. Reason: sustained healthcheck failures on shard-set-az3 (prefix-cache evictions + controlplane-heartbeat 5xx). Auto-escalation enabled. https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC-4829

sre_oncall: acked on pd (INC-4829). Looking now. early signal: 5xx spike started ~1708801180, latency up, then prefix-cache churn.

megan: seeing repeated cache evictions in logs, likely a memory pressure/coldstart churn pattern. customer-impact: some Dedicated customers in az3 report generation timeouts / 502s.

jgonzalez: can we divert new traffic off az3 to az2/az4 temporarily? what's the current routing policy?

ops_lead: routing policy = latency-weighted with region-fallback enabled. We can force divert for the cluster group serving prod-models-1. I'll prepare a manual routing rule.

alice: paging PD to prevent further escalations and suppress integration alerts while we triage. pd-bot: please confirm suppression window?

pagerduty-bot: suppression applied to downstream alert group for 30m by alice. PD status: ACKED -> escalating to ops_lead if no action in 10m.

bob: quick check — autoscaler in az3 is at 95% CPU, but new pods fail liveness due to kv-cache miss storms. suspect kv-store eviction. logs: ```
2024-02-24T14:07:12Z runtime[shard-az3]: kvcache: evict key batch-0-ht failed: oom
2024-02-24T14:07:18Z runtime[shard-az3]: follower rejoin: rehydrating kv cache, miss-rate 0.82
```

megan: thanks. I'll trigger a cache rehydrate command for the shard set and scale up standby nodes to reduce coldstart pressure. Command I'm running now: ```
infractl nodes scale --region az3 --group prod-shard-3 --count +3 --reason "prod coldstart rehydrate"
infractl kvcache rehydrate --shard prod-shard-3 --mode gradual --batch 50
```

sre_oncall: started those. status: scale job queued (job#8742). rehydrate in progress, streaming logs show decreasing miss-rate to ~0.45.

ops_lead: preparing manual routing divert in 2m. rule: route weight prod-shard-3 -> az2:80%, az4:20% until healthy. applying now.

alice: applied routing override via routectl: ```
routectl update --target prod-models-1 --weights az2=0.8,az4=0.2 --expires 2024-02-24T15:10:00Z --note "temporary divert for az3 evictions"
```

megan: traffic shifted, error-rate from impacted customers dropped from 6.2% -> 1.1% in 3m. good. continue monitoring.

jgonzalez: can we avoid automatic failover? prefer manual until we confirm shard rehydration; auto-failover could thrash. ops_lead: agree. disabling autopilot failover for prod-models-1 for 20m.

ops_lead: disabled autopilot failover. manual failover will be exec-only by oncall. noting in PD incident.

bob: rehydrate finished. miss-rate now ~0.08, pods stabilized, new pod liveness OK. rolling restart not needed.

sre_oncall: will keep the routing override for 10 more minutes then slowly shift back. preparing handoff to next oncall in 30m with summary.

alice: summary for handoff -> root cause probable kv-cache eviction cascade triggered by burst of coldstarts on az3; mitigation steps: scale + rehydrate + manual routing divert; customer impact: transient 502s for Dedicated in az3, mitigated by divert. next steps: run postmortem, add soft-prefetching to kvcache to reduce coldstart gutter.

megan: filing quick postmortem draft and will attach commands + logs. tagging product/special-cust-success for outreach. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: note added to INC-4829: manual routing applied, autopilot disabled, incident status = monitoring.

incident-bot: closing automated escalations for this thread. handover -> @sre_oncall_next at 1708804800. :handshake:
